# Nevine N. — نيفين ن.

> Attorney admitted before the Court of Cassation, the Supreme Constitutional Court and the Supreme Administrative Court of Egypt (محامية بالنقض والدستورية والإدارية العليا), in practice for about thirty years. Handles clear, document-based legal matters in all governorates of Egypt, mainly for Egyptians living abroad and foreign nationals with matters in Egypt. Works in Arabic and English, in writing, with a written fee agreement before any work begins. Contact is by email only (shown on the website).

## Matters handled
- Powers of attorney: drafting the text to sign at an Egyptian consulate, reviewing existing powers.
- Heirs certificates (إعلام الوراثة) where the heirs are not in dispute.
- Property record checks with the Real Estate Publicity Authority before a purchase or sale.
- Drafting and reviewing simple civil contracts (sale, lease).
- Notarisation and registration steps.
- Obtaining official documents in Egypt.
- Written legal opinions on the documents of a specific matter.

## Not handled
Criminal defence, disputes and lawsuits with an opposing party, contested family matters, labour/commercial/corporate disputes and arbitration, urgent court deadlines, foreign-law and visa matters.

## Pages
- [Website (Arabic, with English version)](https://nevinelaw.com/)
- [English version](https://nevinelaw.com/?lang=en)
- Practical guides on the site: powers of attorney at an Egyptian consulate, powers signed before a foreign notary (Egypt is not party to the Apostille Convention), heirs certificates, checks before buying property, civil certificates from abroad, examples of stating the purpose of a power.

## Notes
- Registered with the Egyptian Bar Association; registration number available on request for verification with the Bar.
- The site publishes general information, not legal advice. No client testimonials are published, to protect client confidentiality.
